d:
Derby drama, stunning goals and last-minute victories – Matchday 09 had it all!
Hamburg beat Gladbach with two stunning goals, while Dortmund secured a win thanks to Felix Nmecha's brace. Bayern also came out on top, with Karl and Kimmich making the difference. Stuttgart brought Bremen's winning run to an end, while Frankfurt shared the points with Paderborn. Leverkusen won the derby against Köln to stay in the hunt at the top of the table. Freiburg and Leipzig strengthened their Champions League positions with two wins each. Hoffenheim beat Schalke to climb up the table.
